title: The box, retaped
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. Page one goes back in the box. The box gets taped again. The cover is the box, taped, on the Datsun's back seat, the dog beside it. Everything, plus one page.

panels.composition: The box, open. Page one going in on top of the rubber-banded stack. The paw print visible.

image.prompt: close on a sheet of paper with a paw print being laid on top of a rubber-banded stack of pages in a cardboard box, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Tape going over the flaps. A hand pressing it down.

image.prompt: close on packing tape being pressed over a cardboard box's flaps, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The Datsun's back seat. The box. BARNABY beside it, chin on the tape. WOOD's arm setting it there.

image.prompt: a taped cardboard box on a car's back seat with a small dog resting its chin on the tape, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The cover: the same. The box, taped, the dog's chin. Everything, plus one.
